question.text: From a collection of 20 consecutive natural numbers, four are selected such that they are not consecutive. The number of such selections is

solution.text:
Given, numbers are $1,2,3 \ldots \ldots .20$ Here, number of ways of selecting four consecutive numbers $=17$
$\because$ Required number of selecting 4 non-consecutive
$$
\begin{aligned}
\text { numbers } &={ }^{20} C_{4}-17 \\
&=\frac{20 \times 19 \times 18 \times 17}{4 \times 3 \times 2 \times 1}-17 \\
&=285 \times 17-17 \\
=& 284 \times 17
\end{aligned}
$$
